promise: Apple Vision Pro... will be available early next year
description: Cook closed Apple's WWDC 2023 keynote by announcing the $3,499 Vision Pro headset and promising availability 'early next year' (2024). It shipped in the US on February 2, 2024 — inside the promised window, though reviews were mixed and sales were weak.
evidence: Announced at WWDC June 5, 2023 with 'available early next year'
Apple newsroom (Jan 8, 2024): 'Apple Vision Pro available in the U.S. on February 2'
